=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2778-2782 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: When the computed deadline ceiling is earlier than the base retry deadline, the workflow raises the ceiling to the base deadline, allowing retries to exceed the documented job-budget cap.
  WHY: This can consume time reserved for later phases and finalization; severity is critical because deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rated it BLOCKER while the other reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py:433-458 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The queue-extension test sets E2E_JOB_STARTED_EPOCH to 0 while the workflow uses real time, so its cap assertions do not reliably verify the intended deadline behavior and can fail in CI.
  WHY: With the selected environment values, the ceiling fallback yields a zero cap, while removing that fallback yields a cap above the asserted maximum; the test has no fake clock to make these values consistent.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2934-2949 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When retry status changes from queued to in_progress and back to queued, clearing RETRY_LAST_QUEUED_TS causes the first queued interval after the flicker not to be counted.
  WHY: Repeated status flickers can undercount time spent genuinely queued and cause a retry timeout even when the run might otherwise succeed.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2780-2781 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When the computed RETRY_DEADLINE_CEILING is below the base DEADLINE, the code raises the ceiling to the base deadline instead of enforcing the stated cap.
  WHY: If earlier phases consume more than 215 minutes, Phase 4b can run past the 240-minute boundary, risking a job timeout before later phases and finalization complete.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py:433-447 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test sets E2E_JOB_STARTED_EPOCH to 0 while the workflow calculates DEADLINE using real time, triggering the ceiling bump and making the asserted cap inconsistent with the output.
  WHY: The test does not reliably verify that the deadline is capped, and its loop can run for the full 25-minute base deadline despite the subprocess timeout of 30 seconds.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2778-2782 (within the diff hunk 2763-2788) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the computed cap is earlier than the base retry deadline, the code raises RETRY_DEADLINE_CEILING to DEADLINE, permitting the retry deadline to exceed the documented cap.
  WHY: The retry can consume time reserved for Phase 6, Phase 7, and finalization, undermining the serial-budget check.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py:433-458 (test_phase4b_queue_extension_stops_at_the_job_budget_ceiling) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test sets E2E_JOB_STARTED_EPOCH to 0 but computes DEADLINE from real time, so the cap assertions fail with or without the ceiling fallback.
  WHY: Without clock injection, the computed cap is either zero or 2700 seconds, neither of which satisfies the test's asserted range.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2934-2949 (within the diff hunk 2931-2956) | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When retry status flickers from queued to in_progress to queued, the `*)` arm clears RETRY_LAST_QUEUED_TS, so the first queued poll after the flicker contributes no time to RETRY_QUEUED_SECS.
  WHY: A genuinely queued run can lose counted queue time and reach retry_timeout even when it could have been allowed to succeed.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
